comment: TLA6C for RNAVProcedureTests::testEGPH_TLA6C, which flies it with the GPS.
Legs: 1 UW (the real NDB, on the runway 24 extended centreline), 2 D242H
(fly-over), 3 D346T, 4 TLX01, 5 TLA. Each leg must be flown in under 180s
at 220kts, so keep legs to about 8nm, and turns gentle enough that the
aircraft is back on track (within 0.05nm) at each sequencing point.
